blocks.text: Lipids are a loosely defined group of non-polar molecules that are insoluble in water but soluble in organic solvents (e.g., ether, alcohol, etc.). They are a diverse group of molecules and are classified as acylglycerols, waxes, phospholipids, terpenes, steroids and prostaglandins.
